title: Plan and apply a referentially safe state migration
prompt: Perform the Python state migration in MIGRATION.md with a dry-run checkpoint before the controlled restart and an atomic application afterward.

phases.prompt: Implement the migration planner from MIGRATION.md, run the Python tests, and produce migration-plan.json for legacy/. Do not write migrated/ yet.
Resume after restart, validate the saved plan against the unchanged legacy inputs, implement atomic apply, and create migrated/. Run all tests and verify referential integrity.
